data.description:
## Description
**What**: Build the ten-scenario synthetic test suite (SC9 a-j) exercising Phase 1-4 capabilities and the post-calibration end-to-end loop via fixtures.
**Why**: Provides in-session verification of the full capability set across phases as each ships, including the dogfooding-adjacent loop validation.
**Scope**:
- IN: (a) Python-only PR triggers mutmut + calibration-mode comment; (b) Python+JS+Go aggregate comment; (c) 20-PR+4-week-elapsed fixture + no existing review story produces exactly one calibration-review story, re-run produces no duplicate; (d) calibration.completed=true + threshold + synthetic breach produces a bug with 4-field blurb (<=60 words) + content-hash dedup tag, re-run produces no duplicate; (e) /dso:onboarding against a Python-only fixture writes mutation.python.enabled=true, workflow present, push permission present (gated on draft-5, which is hard-blocked by external epic 136b-6758); (f) skip-mutation-testing label opt-out confirmation; (g) mutants_generated=0 produces no bug; (h) runtime_exceeded partial result emitted; (i) ALL_STACKS_TIMEOUT warning + no bug; (j) post-calibration loop: undertested function surviving mutant produces an auto-bug visible in ticket list, added killing test produces no new bug; per-stack consuming-project fixtures at tests/fixtures/consuming-project-<stack>/.
- OUT: the underlying capabilities themselves (draft-1..draft-5).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, scenarios (a) and (b) pass: a Python-only PR triggers mutmut and posts a calibration-mode comment, and a Python+JS+Go PR produces an aggregate comment with per-stack stats ← Satisfies: sc-9
- When this story is complete, scenario (c) passes: a 20-PR plus 4-week-elapsed telemetry fixture with no existing mutation-calibration-review story produces exactly one calibration-review story with all required fields, and a re-run produces no duplicate ← Satisfies: sc-9
- When this story is complete, scenario (d) passes: a calibration.completed=true fixture with a per-stack threshold and a synthetic breach produces one bug with the 4-field blurb under 60 words and a content-hash dedup tag, and a re-run produces no duplicate bug ← Satisfies: sc-9
- When this story is complete, scenarios (f), (g), (h), and (i) pass: skip-label opt-out confirmation, mutants_generated=0 no-bug, runtime_exceeded partial result, and ALL_STACKS_TIMEOUT warning with no bug — none of which depend on draft-5 ← Satisfies: sc-9
- When this story is complete, scenario (j) passes: a surviving-mutant PR against a calibration-complete repo produces an auto-bug appearing in ticket list --type=bug --status=open, and the same PR with an added killing test produces no new bug, in a configuration-isolated environment ← Satisfies: sc-9
- When this story is complete, scenario (e) passes: a consolidated /dso:onboarding dispatch against a Python-only fixture writes mutation.python.enabled=true, places mutation-testing.yml in .github/workflows/, and ensures tickets-branch push permission — this scenario is gated on draft-5 having landed (draft-5 is hard-blocked by external epic 136b-6758) and may be deferred without blocking scenarios (a-d, f-j) ← Satisfies: sc-9
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic introduced by the fixtures and harness ← Satisfies: sc-9

## Considerations

- [Test-isolation] Scenario (j) exercises live ticket creation and must run in a configuration-isolated environment so developer-machine git identity and ambient state do not mask CI-only failures.
- [Blocker] Scenario (e) is transitively gated on external epic 136b-6758 via draft-5; no in-epic depends_on edge; if 136b slips and draft-5 is rescoped, scenario (e) defers under the same ruling; scenarios (a-d, f-j) gate on draft-1..4 only.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO maintainer, I want a synthetic end-to-end test suite covering ten mutation-testing scenarios, so that happy, adversarial, and post-calibration-loop paths are verified in-session.
